evidence: unreadable: In hook@0.3 and hook@1.5 the subtitle 'carbon dioxide in the air · 2024' runs into the dashed ghost circles, so '2024' sits on the marks. In seg3:start and seg4:mid the '1990' ghost label is jammed against the right frame edge.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start, seg3:mid and seg3:end are nearly the same frame. The header reads 'Pollen / how thick it hangs in the air · 1990' through the whole beat while the narration says '21 percent thicker'. The pollen cloud only edges past its dashed 1990 outline, and '+21%' first appears in the closing card (seg4:mid). Data stands beside a stalk with his arm out and does nothing.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The number lands after the beat ends, so the scene spends its whole window in the 'before' state. The change the cloud shows is too small to see at a glance. Data has no act that causes the pollen.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Land '+21%' and a 2018 header by about 70% of seg3, and make the cloud clearly thicker and denser than its 1990 outline, not just a little bigger. Give Data a causal act, such as shaking or striking the ragweed stalk so a burst of pollen thickens the cloud. Keep the '1990' ghost label fully inside the frame.
